entries.english: Upload a hand-drawn plan of your land (or a photo of one). Lima reads it and lays out a permaculture design on your sketch, using this site's climate, soil, sun and wind.
entries.st: Kenya moralo wa naha ya hao o takilweng ka letsoho (kapa senepe sa wona). Lima e a o bala mme e beha moralo wa permaculture hodima setshwantsho sa hao, e sebedisa boemo ba lehodimo, mobu, letsatsi le moya tsa sebaka sena.
entries.ts: Layicha pulani ya misava ya wena leyi dirowiweke hi voko (kumbe xifaniso xa yona). Lima wa yi hlaya kutani a veka dizayini ya permaculture eka xiketsa xa wena, a tirhisa maxelo, misava, dyambu ni moya swa ndhawu leyi.
entries.ve: Laisani pulane ya mavu aṋu yo oliwaho nga tshanḓa (kana tshifanyiso tshayo). Lima u a i vhala a dzudzanya pulane ya permaculture kha tshiketshe tshaṋu, a tshi shumisa mutsho, mavu, ḓuvha na muya zwa fhethu afha.

entries.english: Ask about your site, crops, soil & water, finances, or project. Tap the camera to photograph a plant or pest for a diagnosis. Organic & regenerative only.
entries.st: Botsa ka sebaka sa hao, dijalo, mobu le metsi, ditjhelete kapa projeke. Tobetsa khamera ho nka senepe sa semela kapa sesenyi hore se hlahlojwe. Ka temo ya tlhaho le e tsosolosang feela.
entries.ts: Vutisa hi ndhawu ya wena, swibyariwa, misava ni mati, timali kumbe phurojeke. Tinya khamera u teka xifaniso xa ximilana kumbe xitsotswana leswaku xi hlahluviwa. Ku tirhisiwa tindlela ta vurimi bya ntumbuluko ni ku pfuxeta ntsena.
entries.ve: Vhudzisani nga fhethu haṋu, zwiliṅwa, mavu na maḓi, tshelede kana thandela. Kwamani khamera u dzhie tshifanyiso tsha tshimela kana tshikhokhonono uri tshi ṱolwe. Ndi zwa vhulimi ha mupo na u vusuludza fhedzi.

entries.english: A guided look at your maps, crop plans, harvests, sales and invoices. Practise with Ubhejane Crèche Garden, then return to your own work.
entries.zu: Bheka amamephu akho, izinhlelo zezitshalo, izivuno, ukuthengisa nama-invoyisi ngokuqondiswa. Zilolonge e-Ubhejane Crèche Garden, bese ubuyela emsebenzini wakho.
entries.st: Ketelo e tataiswang ya dimmapa, meralo ya dijalo, dikotulo, dithekiso le di-invoice tsa hao. Ikwetlise ka Ubhejane Crèche Garden, ebe o kgutlela mosebetsing wa hao.
entries.ts: Riendzo leri kongomisiwaka ra mimepe, tipulani ta swibyariwa, ntshovelo, ku xavisa ni ti-invoice ta wena. Titolovete hi Ubhejane Crèche Garden, kutani u tlhelela eka mintirho ya wena.
entries.ve: Lwendo lu livhiswaho lwa mimapa, pulane dza zwiliṅwa, khaṋo, thengiso na dzi-invoice dzaṋu. Ḓiḓowedzeni nga Ubhejane Crèche Garden, ni kone u humela kha mushumo waṋu.

entries.english: Review your assigned farmers, garden visits and training records.
entries.zu: Buyekeza abalimi ababelwe wena, ukuvakashelwa kwezingadi namarekhodi okuqeqeshwa.
entries.st: Hlahloba balemi bao o ba abetsweng, diketelo tsa dirapa le ditlaleho tsa thupelo.
entries.ts: Kambisisa varimi lava u averiweke vona, maendzo ya swirhapa ni tirhekhodo ta ndzetelo.
entries.ve: Ṱolani vhalimi vhe na avhelwa, madalo a ngade na rekhodo dza vhugudisi.

entries.ts: Kambisisa swirhapa, mikambelo ni swiviko eka nongonoko wa wena hinkwaro.
entries.ve: Ṱolani ngade, ṱhaṱhuvho na mivhigo kha mbekanyamushumo yaṋu yoṱhe.

entries.english: It grows as you find your land, trace its boundary, survey it, design it and plan crops.
entries.zu: Liyakhula njengoba uthola indawo yakho, ulandelela umngcele wayo, uyihlola, uyiklama futhi uhlele izitshalo.
entries.st: Le hola ha o fumana naha ya hao, o taka moedi wa yona, o e hlahloba, o e rala mme o rera dijalo.
entries.ts: Xa kula loko u kuma misava ya wena, u dirowa ndzilekano, u yi kambisisa, u yi dizayina kutani u kunguhata swibyariwa.
entries.ve: Tshi a hula musi ni tshi wana mavu aṋu, ni ola mukano waho, ni a ṱola, ni a pulana na u pulana zwiliṅwa.
